$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only. Files under frontend/src/app that still set interface text below the 11px floor (see docs/design-system.md, Typography). Each entry is '<path relative to frontend>: <token>', deduplicated per file and token. sharedUiAccessibility.test.ts asserts the live set equals this list, so a NEW sub-11px token fails the build and a listed one may only be removed together with its code. Permanent, documented exception: 'src/app/components/ui/user-avatar.tsx: text-[8px]' is the 16px table-avatar monogram (docs/design-system.md). The rest are pre-existing offenders removed by W29 and W31 as their screens are polished.
